description: Independent component checks. READY only when every blocking component is ready. Details are drawn from a fixed catalogue: no connection string, path or exception text can appear here.
title: PGx API readiness report (WP-16)

x-pgx-detail-catalogue.argon2_missing: Argon2id password hashing is unavailable, and there is no weaker algorithm to fall back to.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.audit_chain_unverified: The governed audit chain has not been verified in this deployment.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.audit_sink_missing: No canonical governed audit sink is composed, so no governed state change may proceed.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.auth_not_permitted: The configured authentication provider is not permitted in this environment.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.claim_boundary_not_approved: The claim boundary has not been approved by the named human and scientific reviewers. This is a governance gate, not a fault.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.composition_incomplete: A service this environment requires is not configured.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.config_invalid: Application configuration is incomplete or refused.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.database_unreachable: The database did not answer within the probe budget.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.driver_missing: The database driver is not installed in this deployment.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.evidence_build_missing: No evidence build is configured, so evidence records cannot be read.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.migrations_behind: The database schema is not at the revision this build expects.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.migrations_unknown: The schema revision could not be determined.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.rate_limiter_missing: No rate-limit backend is composed; login and governed mutations fail closed.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.release_invalid: The active release did not verify against its recorded hashes.
x-pgx-detail-catalogue.session_store_missing: No server-side session store is composed, so no session can be created or validated.

x-pgx-external-services-excluded: No third-party service is a component. P0 readiness must not depend on anyone else's availability.
